chunks.arabic_text: أَبِي رَحِمَهُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ٱبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ عَ يَقُولُ

translations.en: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Abdullah ibn Ja'far narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Najran, who said: I heard Abu al-Hasan (AS) saying:

chunks.arabic_text: مَنْ عَادَى شِيعَتَنَا فَقَدْ عَادَانَا وَ مَنْ وَالاَهُمْ فَقَدْ وَلاَنَا لِأَنَّهُمْ مِنَّا خُلِقُوا مِنْ طِينَتِنَا مَنْ أَحَبَّهُمْ فَهُوَ مِنَّا وَ مَنْ أَبْغَضَهُمْ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا

translations.en: He who antagonizes our Shia is antagonizing us, and whoever follows them is following us, because they are from us; they were created from our clay. He who loves them is from us, and whoever hates them is not from us.

chunks.arabic_text: شِيعَتُنَا يَنْظُرُونَ بِنُورِ ٱللَّهِ وَ يَتَقَلَّبُونَ فِي رَحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَ يَفُوزُونَ بِكَرَامَةِ ٱللَّهِ

translations.en: Our Shia see through the light of Allah, move about in the mercy of Allah, and will win the dignity of Allah.

chunks.arabic_text: مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ شِيعَتِنَا يَمْرَضُ إِلاَّ مَرِضْنَا لِمَرَضِهِ وَ لاَ ٱغْتَمَّ إِلاَّ ٱغْتَمَمْنَا لِغَمِّهِ وَ لاَ يَفْرَحُ إِلاَّ فَرِحْنَا لِفَرَحِهِ

translations.en: No one of our Shia falls ill but we feel ill for his illness, nor is he grieved but we feel grief for his grief, nor does he rejoice but we rejoice for his joy.

chunks.arabic_text: وَ لاَ يَغِيبُ عَنَّا أَحَدٌ مِنْ شِيعَتِنَا أَيْنَ كَانَ فِي شَرْقِ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَوْ غَرْبِهَا

translations.en: And no one of our Shia is absent from us, wherever he is in the east or west of the earth.

chunks.arabic_text: وَ مَنْ تَرَكَ مِنْ شِيعَتِنَا دَيْناً فَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا وَ مَنْ تَرَكَ مِنْهُمْ مَالاً فَهُوَ لِوَرَثَتِهِ

translations.en: The debt left by any of our Shia is upon us, and the wealth left by them is for his heirs.

chunks.arabic_text: شِيعَتُنَا ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلاَةَ وَ يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَاةَ وَ يَحُجُّونَ ٱلْبَيْتَ ٱلْحَرَامَ وَ يَصُومُونَ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَ يُوَالُونَ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَ يَتَبَرَّءُونَ مِنْ أَعْدَائِهِمْ [مِنْ أَعْدَائِنَا]

translations.en: Our Shia are those who establish the prayer, pay the alms-tax, perform the pilgrimage to the Holy House, fast during the month of Ramadan, show loyalty to the People of the House, and declare disavowal of their enemies [our enemies].

chunks.arabic_text: أُولَئِكَ أَهْلُ ٱلْإِيمَانِ وَ ٱلتُّقَى وَ أَهْلُ ٱلْوَرَعِ وَ ٱلتَّقْوَى

translations.en: Those are the people of faith and piety, the people of scrupulousness and God-consciousness.

chunks.arabic_text: وَ مَنْ رَدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَدْ رَدَّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَ مَنْ طَعَنَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَدْ طَعَنَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ لِأَنَّهُمْ عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ حَقّاً وَ أَوْلِيَاؤُهُ صِدْقاً

translations.en: And whoever rejects them has rejected Allah, and whoever strikes at them has struck at Allah, because they are truly the servants of Allah and His genuine friends.

chunks.arabic_text: وَ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ أَحَدَهُمْ لَيَشْفَعُ فِي مِثْلِ رَبِيعَةَ وَ مُضَرَ فَيُشَفِّعُهُ ٱللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِيهِمْ لِكَرَامَتِهِ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ.

translations.en: By Allah, one of them will intercede for as many people as the tribes of Rabi'ah and Mudar, and Allah the Exalted will grant his intercession for them out of His honor. Upon Allah be the glory and majesty.

en.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Sifat al-Shia*, Imam ar-Rida (AS) establishes the ontological closeness of the Shia to the Imams, describing them as created from the Imams' 'clay' and sharing in their emotional states, which underscores the concept of *al-Wala'* and *al-Bara'* as defining characteristics of true faith. The text emphasizes that the Shia are not merely followers but spiritual extensions of the Imams, whose prayers carry significant weight for intercession, thereby linking personal piety with communal loyalty to the Ahl al-Bayt. This narrative reinforces the Shia theological view that love for the Imams is intrinsic to the structure of belief itself.
en.seo_question: What are the characteristics and spiritual status of the Shia according to Imam ar-Ridha (AS)?

key_terms.أَهْلُ ٱلْبَيْتِ: The People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.رَبِيعَةُ وَمُضَرُ: Rabi'ah and Mudar (major Arab tribes, representing large numbers)
